purpose: Local CPU inference cost for all nine frozen official39 primary references; no quality scoring, training, model selection or held-out arrays
candidates: All full39 final-at-step20 light/iid/dirichlet models, seeds7/17/27, identified by the existing final evaluation plan and final-test model-state receipts
inputs: Uniform training-only row sample without replacement; existing standardized float32 full39 features; labels never loaded. Prebuild tensors outside timed region. Same rows/order for every model
order: All18 model/batch cases rotated by repeat index; use all repetitions, not the fastest. A second independent process repeats the full protocol
timed_scope: Warm-cache PyTorch eager CPU forward plus argmax on prebuilt input tensors. Excludes feature extraction, scaling, transfer, tensor creation, model/data loading and service overhead. Not end-to-end packet latency
reporting: Per-repeat mean ms/call; median and min/max of those means, and throughput computed from median batch duration. These are NOT per-request tail percentiles. All9 seeds/models reported, no significant lane-speed ranking inferred
integrity: Verify archive and model-state hashes against reviewed final evidence; replay a fixed training-input prediction fingerprint before/after benchmark; model weights unchanged; no backward or optimizer calls
hardware: Read CPU model and RAM only; retain OS/Python/Torch/NumPy/thread metadata. Local Mac results are NOT measured Jetson/edge latency, power, distributed network latency or cloud speedup
